_comment: Everything in source seconds. Cuts are structural (from the segment map). Stretches are the silent-but-moving spans scan_signals.py found (ids from signals.json); anything not listed is kept as recorded. Dead air is derived, not listed. Disclosures come from the visual pass and are only checked - every one must fall inside a cut or a blur window with that region, or QA fails.

stretches.why: tab flick, then waiting on a response
report streams in and the speaker refers to it
scroll to the bottom of the ledger

disclosures.what: client channel names in the left rail
a client report in the message body
a customer's email open full screen

_mute: SOURCE seconds, word start -> word end from the words file. Every word matching flag_words (default: a profanity list) must be cut, muted, or in allow, or the build dies.
